reuse.why: The change reuses tag extraction, spreadsheet access, budget writes, batching, undo registration, and setNMonthAvg while sharing category selection across all month-wide actions.

duplication.why: Repeated category queries and average-action loops are consolidated, although the income-category eligibility guard remains repeated across four action implementations.

placement.why: Budget selection and calculations remain in actions.ts, with method typing and undoable registration in app.ts following existing layering.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, relevant tests, and release documentation.

maintainability.why: The shared selector and average runner make future changes straightforward, though centralizing income eligibility would make the selector a more complete definition of writable categories.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All affected month-wide actions use getMonthWideTargetCategories, and average actions delegate to the existing setNMonthAvg.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated selection queries and average loops are replaced with shared helpers rather than reshaped copies.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideTargetCategories gains the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter and conditional hidden-filter branch; every affected action continues through this selector.
